answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 23563 Country: India Title: I am a converted muslim male, now i am getting touching the age of marriage, i completed my education and earning very good amount of money. Now problem is: As iam converted muslim guy no muslim family is ready to give he his daughter and being a muslim i can not marry a non-muslim girl. My marry was fixxed with a muslim girl before some months ago; but when his father/brother comes to know about my background; they ditched me and decided they will not marry his daughter to me. Please help me to solve the problem. Question: I am a converted muslim male, now i am getting touching the age of marriage, i completed my education and earning very good amount of money. Now problem is: As iam converted muslim guy no muslim family is ready to give he his daughter and being a muslim i can not marry a non-muslim girl. My marry was fixxed with a muslim girl before some months ago; but when his father/brother comes to know about my background; they ditched me and decided they will not marry his daughter to me. Please help me to solve the problem. Answer ID: 23563 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1376/1016/H=1431) Recite the following ayah after each salah 3 times with durood 3-3 times before and after, and supplicate Almighty Allah: O Allah, arrange for me pious wife. Amen! رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً [الفرقان : 74] Also repeat the same before going to bed. Sleep in the state of wudhu and according to sunnah and follow sunnah in each and every deed. May you attain firmness in religion, may Almighty Allah save you from all harms and bless you with pious wife as soon as possible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
